caption:
Keep doing good, even if no one notices

One short question in Surah Ar-Rahman, and the answer is already inside it. Be good to people today, whether they notice or not.

Surah Ar-Rahman 55:60

Name one good thing someone did for you this week.

#ihsan #surahrahman #doinggood #quranreels

Recitation: Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary
